title: Cod to Lanternfish
description: Changes Cod and all cod textures and texts (item names, subtitles, etc) to Lanternfish
body:
deep sea fish special interest is taking over my life

its based off the Cocos Lanternfish specifically ([Gonichthys cocco](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gonichthys_cocco))﻿

Changes the Cod textures (item, spawn eggs, entity, etc) to a Lanternfish

Changes language files for the standard (the non-joke ones) english languages to say Lanternfish instead of Cod
